title: Q-SYS-FAILURE-REGISTRY: SYS-3: loops and the executor file their own failures, deduplicated by signature
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** file:foundation/failures.py
**Status:** open

Owner directive 2026-11-12: a system is an integrated collection of parts, not one worker and a database.

A failed executor or loop run must become a queue item with owner, trigger and closing probe without a person or a session: signature (loop, first error line), count, last seen, link to the run. Same signature twice mutates the approach; three times files an incident item. The /live page shows the registry.
Paths: foundation/failures.py, foundation/executor.py, foundation/transparency.py, tests/foundation/test_failures.py.
Acceptance: a simulated failing run files exactly one item and increments its count on repeat.

size: L

**Closing probe:** file:foundation/failures.py exists and its tests pass.
